description: The file defines the EditEmployeeAttendanceController class, which manages the pre-render logic for editing employee attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It retrieves attendance data, checks permissions, and prepares Vue.js component properties for the front end.

classes.name: EditEmployeeAttendanceController
classes.description: Controller for editing employee attendance entries, extends the abstract Vue controller and utilizes attendance-related services to manage pre-render logic.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Handles pre-render logic by retrieving attendance data based on request parameters, validating permissions, and setting up Vue.js component properties.
